topic_title: Legal Speed Limits for Texas Roadways & Beaches
prompt: What is the highest legal posted speed limit authorized anywhere on the Texas state highway system?

options.text: Seventy-five miles per hour on designated interstate freeway segments
Eighty-five miles per hour on designated toll roads like State Highway 130
Eighty miles per hour on rural interstate corridors in West Texas counties
Ninety miles per hour on limited-access state toll road facilities
